set.body:
Type: acceptance gate
Work key: H04
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Performance/backend lead
Scope: Whole inventories, frozen selections and streaming lifetimes can escape apparent request limits.

Work kind: acceptance-gate
Suggested delivery tranche: T5; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A versioned engineering workload fixes corpus, cardinalities, concurrent roles, history, cache modes, machine/resource budgets and numeric latency/resource thresholds before qualification; current import limits remain explicit.
2. Inventory/history/directory/selection pagination bounds database work and decoded/serialized state as well as page output; authorization/cursor/race cases preserve exact release semantics and hide forbidden rows/counts.
3. The repeatable workload meets declared budgets under readers, writers and slow downloads while preserving correctness, cancellation and fair metadata access. Raw distributions, database plans, memory and failures are retained; no institutional capacity claim is inferred.

Expected review receipt: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H04/receipt.json

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/institutional-readiness-backlog.json

Blocked by:
- H04.1: bd-01M4X8MAT0FE5J2NXNWK4ZXTH8
- W02.1: bd-01M4W5PB5NYNV2A8EFBQKXPEBZ
- Q01.2: bd-01M4W5PBV2N5ECB8WMAYB689B6
- H04.2: bd-01M4X8MAYAJRT50TKYR5JCP7R4

Review existing implementation receipts against this cross-cutting area. Do not duplicate or reparent their tasks. Close only with observed evidence; planning and previous unrelated tests are insufficient.

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H04: Review core: Bounded catalog and workload performance
